program:
app "Length" calc ocean
state u pick Metres|Feet|Inches|Km|Miles = Metres
state v num = 1
field v "Value"
choice u
let m = v * if(u = Metres, 1, if(u = Feet, 0.3048, if(u = Inches, 0.0254, if(u = Km, 1000, 1609.34))))
grid 2 gap 1
  stack card
    "Metres" faint
    round(m * 100) / 100 head
  stack card
    "Feet" faint
    round(m / 0.3048 * 100) / 100 head
  stack card
    "Inches" faint
    round(m / 0.0254 * 100) / 100 head
  stack card
    "Km" faint
    round(m / 1000 * 1000) / 1000 head
  stack card
    "Miles" faint
    round(m / 1609.34 * 1000) / 1000 head
describe:
Length, in the ocean colours.
Works out:
- m is v times 1 when u is Metres, otherwise 0.3048 when u is Feet, otherwise 0.0254 when u is Inches, otherwise 1000 when u is Km, otherwise 1609.34.
Remembers while you use it: u, starting at Metres; v, starting at 1.
Shows:
- a box to fill in v, labelled "Value".
- a choice of u.
- a grid of 2 columns:
  - text: "Metres".
  - text: m times 100 rounded divided by 100.
  - text: "Feet".
  - text: m divided by 0.3048 times 100 rounded divided by 100.
  - text: "Inches".
  - text: m divided by 0.0254 times 100 rounded divided by 100.
  - text: "Km".
  - text: m divided by 1000 times 1000 rounded divided by 1000.
  - text: "Miles".
  - text: m divided by 1609.34 times 1000 rounded divided by 1000.
hurried_style: a short question, 4 to 10 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "My Marriage fund" gift plum
table deposit amount money, note text?
setting goal money = 2000000
setting monthly money = 10000 "Monthly saving"
let total = sum(deposit.amount)
let p = clamp(total / goal, 0, 1)
let nm = if(goal <= total, 0, floor((goal - total) / monthly) + if((goal - total) % monthly > 0, 1, 0))
row gap 3
  draw 40, 120 width 60
    rect 14, 6, 12, 92 fill soft radius 6
    rect 14, 98 - 92 * p, 12, 92 * p fill accent radius 6
    circle 20, 106, 12 fill accent
  stack grow
    total big
    round(p * 100) "% of" goal faint
    "At this pace:" monthname(addmonths(today, nm)) faint
quick deposit, amount, [5000, 10000]
form deposit
list deposit by day
describe:
My Marriage fund, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- deposit: amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: goal: money, starts at 2000000; "Monthly saving": money, starts at 10000.
Works out:
- total is the total amount of deposit.
- p is total divided by goal kept between 0 and 1.
- nm is 0 when goal is at most total, otherwise the result of goal minus total divided by monthly rounded down plus 1 when the result of goal minus total leaves over when divided by monthly is more than 0, otherwise 0.
Shows:
- a drawing made of rectangles, circles.
- text: total.
- text: p times 100 rounded, "% of", goal.
- text: "At this pace:", the month of today moved by nm months.
- one-tap buttons that add a deposit with amount set to each of 5000, 10000.
- a form to add a deposit.
- a list of deposit by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with who it is for

app "My Zakat and tip" calc slate
setting cash money = 0 "Cash and bank"
setting gold num = 0 "Gold (grams)"
setting silver num = 0 "Silver (grams)"
setting gold_rate money = 0 "Gold price per gram"
setting silver_rate money = 0 "Silver price per gram"
setting debts money = 0 "Debts due now"
state bill money = 0
state tip num = 10
state people num = 1
let wealth = cash + gold * gold_rate + silver * silver_rate - debts
let nisab = 612.36 * silver_rate
screen zakat "Zakat" coin
  field cash
  field gold
  field silver
  field gold_rate
  field silver_rate
  field debts
  if(wealth >= nisab, "Zakat due (2.5%)", "Below nisab: no zakat due") faint
  round(if(wealth >= nisab, wealth * 0.025, 0)) big
screen split "Tip" calc
  field bill "Bill"
  "Tip" tip "%" faint
  slider tip 0..30
  "People" people faint
  slider people 1..20
  "Tip" round(bill * tip / 100) head
  "Each pays" round(bill * (1 + tip / 100) / people) big

program:
app "Events" calendar plum
table event name text, day date
each event where day >= today sort day
  stack card gap 1
    draw 100, 6
      rect 0, 0, 100, 6 fill soft radius 3
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(1 - (it.day - today) / 30, 0.05, 1), 6 fill if(it.day - today <= 3, bad, if(it.day - today <= 10, warn, good)) radius 3
    row
      it.name bold grow
      it.day - today "days left"
form event, "Add event"
remind "Do not forget to log" at 21:00
describe:
Events, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- event: name: text; day: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- for each event where day is at least today sorted by day:
  - a drawing made of rectangles.
  - text: its name.
  - text: its day minus today, "days left".
- a form to add a event.
Reminder "Do not forget to log" at 21:00 every day.

program:
app "Gym" dumbbell mint
table plan day pick Mon|Wed|Fri, exercise text, sets num 1..10 = 3, reps num 1..30 = 10
table lift exercise ref plan, kg num 0..
setting start date = today "Programme start"
"Week" clamp(floor((today - start) / 7) + 1, 1, 12) "of 12" head
each options plan.day as dd
  dd head
  each plan where day = dd as p
    state w num = 0
    stack card gap 1
      row gap 1
        p.exercise bold grow
        p.sets "x" p.reps faint
      row gap 1
        field w "Weight lifted (kg)"
        button "Log" tap add lift exercise = p, kg = w
      trend p.lift sort at, it.kg
      "Best" max(p.lift.kg) "kg" faint
form plan, "Add exercise"
describe:
Gym, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- plan: day: one of Mon, Wed, Fri; exercise: text; sets: number, 1 to 10, starts at 3; reps: number, 1 to 30, starts at 10. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- lift: exercise: a plan; kg: number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Programme start": date, starts at today.
Shows:
- text: "Week", the result of today minus start divided by 7 rounded down plus 1 kept between 1 and 12, "of 12".
- for each choice of the day of the plan:
  - text: the choice.
  - for each plan where day is the choice:
    - text: the exercise of the plan.
    - text: the sets of the plan, "x", the reps of the plan.
    - a box to fill in w, labelled "Weight lifted (kg)".
    - a button "Log"; a tap adds a lift with exercise set to the plan, kg set to w.
    - a line chart of its kg over the plan's lift sorted by at.
    - text: "Best", the highest kg of the plan's lift entries, "kg".
- a form to add a plan.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the numbers or units
